records.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: pixel art character family exploration sheet for a cozy top-down multiplayer social game. Create ONE landscape character design board showing EXACTLY FIVE original tiny human avatars, full bodies, evenly spaced in one horizontal row, same scale and front-facing top-down RPG three-quarter perspective (see face and small top of hair). Direction 01, 'Warm pocket humans': squat bean-shaped human silhouettes with large head merging into tiny torso, no neck, two dot eyes, clearly human hair, simple hoodies/tshirts/overalls, stubby little feet and tiny arms. Approximately 20x28 source pixels per character, deliberately chunky crisp low-resolution pixel art enlarged nearest-neighbor, one dark brown pixel outline, minimal one-step shading, no antialiasing. Cozy terracotta, mustard, sage, dusty blue, cream clothing; varied skin tones and distinct hairstyles (curly bob, dark short hair, blond fringe, afro, ponytail). Recognizably human but compact and playful rather than realistic anatomy. Think simple classic handheld RPG town inhabitants crossed with round stubby bean proportions; all designs original. Neutral warm off-white background, no scenery, no captions, no lettering, no logos, no swatches, no watermark. Exactly 5 separate characters, no extra miniatures, no duplicate rows. Clean comparison board.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original pixel-art avatar family exploration board, direction 02 'Candy bean people'. Generate EXACTLY FIVE tiny human characters in ONE horizontal row, isolated evenly spaced, full bodies identical scale. These are SUPER SIMPLE game sprites, each visually made from ONLY a 16-pixel-wide by 24-pixel-tall grid, enlarged by nearest-neighbor. Every pixel square must be large and visible. Flat hard-edged uniform pixels, no small subpixels, no smooth curves, no gradients, no texture, no detailed illustration. Rounded rectangular bean bodies, almost no neck, giant head is two thirds of height, human hair as one bold simple shape, two single-pixel eyes, tiny shirt body and two short separated feet. Barely visible arms. 3/4 top-down RPG view. Distinct human hairstyles and skin tones, no astronaut visors, no animal ears. Saturated playful pastel clothes: mint, coral pink, lemon, lavender, turquoise. Simple dark plum one-pixel outline, 2 tones per material maximum, maximum 18 colors total. White neutral background, no text, no extra objects, no logos, no scenery, no shadows outside sprites. Original designs, human but compact almost capsule silhouettes. Preserve EXACTLY FIVE individuals, no other rows or small characters.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: pixel art playable human avatar exploration sheet. Direction 03 'Pocket capsule humans'. Very simple short rounded rectangular human silhouettes, compact bean people, total body height only 1.5 heads, head and body nearly merged with no neck, human skin-colored face occupying upper half, simple cap of hair, colored hoodie occupying lower half, tiny feet peeking underneath, arms almost absent. Like tiny human gummy beans. Varied skin tones and simple hairstyles: short fringe, round curls, side bob, top bun, side part. Palette cobalt blue, vermilion, sunflower yellow, jade green and lilac outfits, neutral pale cream background. Gentle top-down RPG angle showing hair top and face. Only two eyes, no noses, no mouths. Original compact human designs, no astronauts, no visor, no animal ears, no scenery, no letters, no logos, no extra characters. Aim much simpler and more capsule-shaped than standard chibi anime characters.
